column1: i am surprised to see miffy so popular now especially in the united states. i grew up with miffy or aka “usako-chan” in japan. baby photos with me wearing miffy clothes holding miffy merch, going to huis ten bosch to explore a miffy store… i feel it’s so odd to see miffy being exposed to mainstream media now! miffy has been here all along where have you guys been?! i know miffy isn’t japanese but it’s a popular character in japan similar to moomin or snoopy; it’s just weird that people are raving about miffy like it’s something new when you’ve grown up with her all along! (｀ｪ´) what do you guys think about the new miffy trend?
Miffy is a character, anyone can start liking miffy lol I grew up with Hello Kitty, and I started to like Miffy for her aesthetics and I like to collect things.

miffy like any other pop culture figure/character is just having her time in the international/global spotlight since global media is so easily accessible now and the covid pandemic saw a huge surge in global interest in asian media. everyone has had this same sentiment at one point for any piece of media!

Can anyone speak on the quality of the quilt and the lamp? Would y’all recommend? I’ve been eyeing these items but they keep getting out of stock so fast! I’m wondering if I should even bother checking anymore. Does the lamp feel cheaply made? What’s the thickness and texture of the quilt? Could someone review these items for me without Miffy tinted glasses on lol

Here’s a closeup of texture of the quilt. The underside is a darker green (more bluish gray) and the miffy heads are on the back too. The miffy parts are like a soft gauze material and the rest of the quilt is a slightly rougher cotton shell that’s a bit scratchy. Maybe it’ll soften with washes idk. It’s very thin. Like 1-2 mm at best (think towel) but the edge is doubled up so it’s a bit thicker (~1cm). You could use it as a throw but I wouldn’t use it to sleep unless your house is like 80F+ or you have something else under it.

First time buying from AE and it’s hard to believe if it’s real or not… it has the emblem of authentication on the box just like from other Miffy blind boxes. To others out there that have the collection is this legit or not? Upon inspecting it, the only cons are the colour bleeding on the jersey which are very minor which can be a manufacturing defect and the shape of the head is rounder and bigger for this soccer collection. Otherwise everything else such as the logo on the back of the head is there, numbers on the bottom of the figure and colour of the face detailing and the feeling of the figurine are all similar to the ancient Miffy collection. The purple Miffy was used for reference for the real thing. Please let me know your opinions or experiences if you also bought anything Miffy from AE thanks!

i’m not an expert on this line specifically, but this seems to be a chinese blind box which means it makes perfect sense for it to be on aliexpress. remember that it’s a collection of storefronts, like amazon is. you can get fake stuff but it’s pretty well known in a lot of blind box communities (eg bjd) that aliexpress is really good for getting legit resale and guaranteed pulls for blindboxes! so i’d say it’s a pretty good chance of being legit.
